fields.question: What is engivexlab?
fields.answer: engivexlab is where we recruit and work with QA testers for our plugins for electrical-engineering and 3D tools such as KiCAD, Altium Designer, Allegro, Blender and Maya. Testers use the plugins in real projects and report bugs and feedback before releases.

fields.question: How do I apply to test a plugin?
fields.answer:
1. Click Sign Up and create your account (or log in with Google).
2. Open Positions and choose a plugin that matches your experience.
3. Click the card to read the description, responsibilities and instruction guideline.
4. Click Apply.

fields.question: Can I apply to more than one position?
fields.answer: Yes. You can apply to every position that fits your skills, once per position. The Apply button changes to "Applied" so you can see where you have already applied.

fields.question: What should I put on my profile?
fields.answer: Add your name, a short line about your experience (Identity), your LinkedIn profile, phone, address, a photo and your personal website if you have one. A complete profile helps our team review your application faster.
